name: 01-rides-uber-ola-rapido
statusMessage: Done: Uber vs Ola, Rapido. 3 opportunities, 3 threats, 6 named issues. Open the Output tab for the battlecard.
verdict: Ola's 1–2★ reviews are 57.6% of its total, versus Uber's 24.8%, so Ola's trust problems are the clearest opening for Uber to win switchers.
issues: Driver cancels or demands extra cash after accepting
Fare increases after booking or at trip end
Long waits and rides not being accepted
Customer support unresponsive, AI-only and unhelpful
Cancellation fees charged though driver cancelled
Unsafe or dangerous drivers and riders
